title: 1816 Prairie's bay windows crowned with carved crests
items: The windows in both of 1816 Prairie's canted bays now carry the same carved, scrolled crest as the front's hoods, as the old photograph of the house shows them.
Still to come on this house: a second dormer in the side crown, the balcony's tall iron railing with a door onto it, and a reading of the 1874 engraving.
